memos.risk:
Ticket size: $5, the floor. Stop: 20%, the tightest allowed. Hold: 15 minutes, no longer.

Refuse any size. The brief shows a bundled curve (bundle_share 1.0, completer_share 0.69, top3 at 0.75) and a launch bot present at graduation, which is the operator-style pattern that has been break-even at best. Post-graduation buying is 315 SOL against 0.9 sell-to-buy, and the last 15 minutes show 1,495 sellers against 1,880 buyers with heavy turnover. A 7.8x run in 30 minutes followed by a 19% drawdown on a 292 SOL pool means a 1.4-5.1% round trip is a meaningful slice of any edge, and a 20% stop can gap through in a thin pool.

My recommendation is to skip. If the desk insists on a probe, the numbers above are the only sane envelope.
memos.scout:
The strongest honest case rests on the last 15 minutes: 1,880 buyers and 4,181 SOL of buy volume, with 1,495 sellers, and net flow of +187 SOL. That is broad participation, not a handful of wallets, and the top-5 buyer share at graduation was only 15%, with no airdrop dump seen. The coin is up 7.8x over 30 minutes and has only pulled back 19% from its high, which is shallower than most collapsing coins. Buyers still outnumber the cohort that sold into a bounce, and 185 non-agent buyers came in during the first two minutes after graduation.

The case weakens fast, though. The curve shows bundle_share of 1.0, so the bonding-curve buying was fully bundled, and the top-3 holders hold 75% of supply. The first-two-minute sell-to-buy ratio of 0.90 and the 15-minute sell volume of 3,994 SOL show heavy distribution. Price is already well off the 30-minute high, and the launch bot is present. Given the base rates for a late entry into a bundled, concentrated coin, I cannot make a strong case that demand holds for the next 30 to 60 minutes after a 30-second fill and 1.4 to 5.1% round-trip cost. A pass is the defensible call.
memos.skeptic: The most likely loss path is a dump by the curve's bundled buyers. Bundle_share is 1.0 and buyers on the curve are only 5, with top3_share at 0.7478 and the completer holding 0.6931 of the curve. That means nearly all supply sits with a handful of wallets, and the 7.76x 30-minute return was largely produced by them. The post-graduation tape shows the same pattern: sell_to_buy_ratio of 0.8958 and 1495 sellers against 1880 buyers in the last 15 minutes, with net flow of only +186.94 SOL on 4180.87 SOL of buys. Organic buying is thin relative to volume, so a single large exit by the bundle or completer would crater price, and a 19.3% drawdown from the 30-minute high has already started. At a 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost on a $20 ticket, even a modest pullback wipes out the edge. Skip.
